notes.title: Join us in our first ever showcase, Chibig Presents, on the 2nd February 2022
notes.notes:
Hi there friends,

We have a very special announcement for today. If you’re a player and a fan of Stories of Mara, you might want to check this: Chibig Presents is a new showcase from our studio on the 2nd February 2022 where we will share with you all the news regarding the shores of Mara and other Chibig Universe titles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817889/798a8d03518e6968c22548b9e64fadc6a521918d.png[/img]

We’re going to talk not only about Stories of Mara, but also about Deiland: Pocket Planet, Summer in Mara, Ankora, and brand new game reveals. We’ve been working really hard this year to bring to you new and exciting games. And not only farm games!

Join us on February 2nd to know more about the new projects and games from us. The event will be streamed in our Steam pages so you can follow the event and catch up with all the new announcements.

We wouldn’t make it without your support! Thank you very much!

See you in Mara!

notes.title: Ankora, our new cute-as-heck exploration adventure, is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

How’s everything? I hope you’re great.

Today we are glad to introduce to you Ankora: Lost Days,[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chibig/ankora-lost-days-a-cute-as-heck-exploration-adventure?ref=4dbbje] our new project on Kickstarter[/url]. Maybe you already know Mûn, from the shores of Mara but you have never seen Mûn like this before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817889/ddc21ffeb4369090856d7d21e2006aa45637e6db.png[/img]

Meet Mûn as a Junior Ranger from the Interstellar Patrol, stranded in Ankora, an unknown planet after her spaceship crashes there. Ankora: Lost Days happens before the events in Deiland: Pocket Planet and Summer in Mara. 

Ankora: Lost Days mixes terraforming, crafting, and exploring mechanics in a wild planet with a colorful style. Mûn must learn to overcome obstacles: rivers, lakes and waterfalls, mountains, level jumps... And many monsters. She will soon learn to make her own paths because Ankora is a unique and changing planet.

For this new campaign, we are happy to announce the partnership with Tesura Games to make a physical edition for Nintendo Switch and Playstation 4 that also includes Deiland: Pocket Planet, and a lot of goodies for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40817889/a9d81af189e4e485e6327b361be43375b69abb47.jpg[/img]

Also, for the first 48 hours, we have a special [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chibig/ankora-lost-days-a-cute-as-heck-exploration-adventure?ref=4dbbje]Early Reward[/url] with a free digital copy of the Ankora Artbook. So hurry up before the time ends!

See you in Ankora!

notes.title: Bug Fixes Report
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Thank you all for the nice welcoming!

We loved you enjoyed Stories of Mara: Chapter One so far! Some of you had reported us some bugs that needed to be fixed, so we did! Here is the list of the errors that have been solved.

-Sound settings.

We wrote a warning about this, and now we've been able to fix it! You can set the volume of the music, the characters, and the UI in the Main Menu or in the Pause Menu without problem.

-Aquila's boats.

If you made a blue model to Aquila, the yellow outcome popped out; and viceversa. Now this is fixed! You can make happy (or not) Aquila again.

-Loop in the Noho, Caleb, Onzo and Akaji conversation at the port.

If you let Noho talk the first time, but interrupted him the second time and regretted that decision, a loop occurred in with Noho started telling the same story from the beginning. This shouldn't occur now.

-Blu's orange, Saimi's gift and Bad Ending achievements.

Due an intern error, these achievements were impossible to get.

-Text errors.

A phrase about Mayo popped out when it shouldn't, and some grammatical errors in the Spanish version were fixed.

-16:10 resolution.

Now you can play the game in 16:9 or in 16:10.

If you find any other bug, or see something that isn't well resolved, please let us know!

Chibig team.

notes.title: Welcome to your tiny planet!
notes.notes:
Welcome to your tiny planet!

The Steam Page for Deiland: Pocket Planet is now live! Deiland: Pocket Planet is a relaxing farming adventure where you will have to take care of your tiny planet set in the same universe as Stories of Mara. 

Farm, craft, and explore in this new version of the original Deiland with unique content. Whether you want to relax, explore or harvest your own crops, your planet is awaiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/475e1ab28970bf5ab7c29afd655fcd1a1b563f4d.png[/img]

This reimagination of Deiland, released previously on Nintendo Switch, including new looks, new music, new playability, and exclusive DLC content released on the previous game. On top of all of this, this new edition includes a new “seasons'' system. 

If you have Deiland, the previous version of the original game, on your Steam Library, don’t worry. You won’t have to purchase it again. Just complete this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfKH6b-Ga1YneVrcRija8zCe6XRlkWOP6yLVsl8tszqMB0Vrg/viewform?usp=sf_link]form[/url] before the game releases and we’ll send a Steam key for Deiland: Pocket Planet for free! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/ebe09b2f97c46d3a5598afb9d450ff1d05e79208.png[/img]

Whether you want to get notified when the game is released or you are waiting to receive your key for having the original Deiland, please add the game to your wishlist! It is a huge help for us. Thank you! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623700/Deiland_Pocket_Planet/

Ease up the bustling, everyday routine taking care of your tiny planet 🥰
